detail: Candidate-38 fresh preparation failed on patch 0537: unable to create temporary file: Invalid argument; fatal: git write-tree failed to write a tree. Full native log unavailable; this is a retained console-error summary. Partial full clone preserved; no surviving task processes after crash.
Bare python executable absent (exit 127); later commands use uv-created environments and explicit .venv interpreters.
Nonblocking shared CPU lock unavailable; empty cpu-tools.log retained. Later work queued on the same lock.
Assumed UID 1000 did not match host user; small edit raised PermissionError. Corrected to observed UID/GID 1002 for only the five task files before retry.
Spaceport local SSH key lacked GitHub access. Publication ran on Spaceport using a short-lived forwarded local SSH agent; no private key/token copied to the node.
